o1.biggest_strength: It puts the right things first: sleep, narrator audio, evening posting, and cutting weak app news/quote/focus content. The six drafts sound warm, simple, and very close to Headspace.
o1.biggest_mistake: The review timing is a little over-cautious and the plan gives weekly angles rather than a fuller 24-post topic map, so the team would still need to fill in some later posts.
o1.what_would_make_it_a_10: Add a simple 24-post topic list for weeks 2 to 4 and tighten the review note to match the exact earliest go-live date.

o2.biggest_strength: It gives the team a very usable 24-post map and correctly builds the plan around narrator clips, sleep, evening posting, and individual tracking.
o2.biggest_mistake: It is a bit less disciplined: the 'sleep posts nearly triple' line is off, the live-stream idea adds distraction and risk, and some wording feels blunter than our warm Headspace voice.
o2.what_would_make_it_a_10: Remove the bolder live-stream test, soften the brand voice, clean up the few data/review details, and make sleep/evening the unmistakable priority throughout.

reason: I would rather hand Output 1 to the team because it is cleaner, safer, and more on-brand. Output 2 has a better 24-post map, but Output 1 makes the core strategic tradeoffs more clearly and the drafts feel more like us.
